fields.quote: Final round of Phase Two fixtures: 23 – 25 April 2027
fields.note: Official FAW season-dates release (1 June 2026). The 16-team league runs a 30-game Phase One (last round 26 March 2027), splits into Championship Race / European Challenger / Survival Zone from 2 April, and the final Phase Two round is played across 23-25 April 2027; 25 April is therefore the last day of league football. The post-season European play-off final (7-8 May) and promotion/relegation final (7-9 May) are excluded as separate matches. The en.wikipedia infobox still says 'TBD 2027'.

fields.quote: JD Cymru North & JD Cymru South ... Final round of fixtures: 16-17 April 2027
fields.note: WAL2 (tier 2, Cymru North) carries the Cymru Premier window in the asset; the same FAW release gives the tier-2 final round as 16-17 April 2027, so 17 April is the last day. Promotion play-off legs (23-25 April, 30 April-2 May) and the promotion/relegation final (7-9 May) are separate matches.

fields.quote: JD Cymru North & JD Cymru South ... Final round of fixtures: 16-17 April 2027
fields.note: WA2S (tier 2, Cymru South) carries the Cymru Premier window in the asset; the FAW release lists Cymru South with the same final round of 16-17 April 2027, so 17 April is the last day. Play-off dates excluded as separate matches.
